assumptions.choice: Approximated ICT Midnight Open level using previous day close (close[-1]) and session open using daily open (open[0])
assumptions.reason: execution feed is 1d daily bars without intraday timestamp resolution for 00:00 ET vs 9:30 ET.

assumptions.choice: Aggressive entry executing market sell order upon signal detection
assumptions.reason: The specification permits aggressive entry at session open, which provides a deterministic execution model for daily bars.

assumptions.choice: Placed at high of the signal bar (high[0])
assumptions.reason: The spec defines stop-loss placement above the initial price spike high; on daily data, the signal day high represents the local maximum of that spike.

assumptions.choice: Full position exit at Level 2 (TP2: previous day high, high[-1] at signal time)
assumptions.reason: The specification allows full position closure upon reaching any of the target levels. For a short trade entered above previous day high, previous day high is the first profit target level reached as price falls.
